name: AK22AH - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared & Electrochemical Sensors, Large Screen
highlights: The AK22A on Infrared and Electrochemical — The largest screen in the range keeps its tiled grid face; CO₂ moves to infrared NDIR and formaldehyde to an electrochemical cell. A big display invites trust — this is the version that earns it.
Why the Pairing Matters — A large screen invites people to trust what it says. Upgraded sensing means the number deserves that trust across humidity swings and cleaning routines.
Full Particulate Split by Laser — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 measured independently.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge, 363 g, 21 pcs per carton.
The Specification Unit of the AK22 Platform — Where a customer asks which model to put in a boardroom or a showroom, this is the answer that survives the follow-up question about accuracy.
